description: This file defines the NodePairingApprovalPrompter class, which manages node pairing approval prompts, including handling incoming pairing requests, user responses, automated approvals, and synchronization with the network state. It utilizes system notifications, asynchronous tasks, and interacts with external gateway services.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A final singleton class responsible for managing node pairing approval prompts, handling user interactions, reconciling network state, and automating approvals when possible.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the pairing prompter, including starting the push task for incoming requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompter, cancels ongoing tasks, clears cached states, and updates pending counts.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending node pairing requests from the gateway, with retries upon failure.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Continuously reconciling with network state to keep local requests in sync with remote resolution status.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a list of pairing requests, updating internal queues and detecting resolved requests.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pairing request prompt if none is currently active.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays a user alert dialog for a pending pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user's response to the pairing prompt, approving or rejecting the node.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval to the gateway for a pairing request.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends rejection to the gateway for a pairing request.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a system notification about the result of a pairing approval or rejection.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to silently approve a pairing request based on SSH probe and user conditions.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Determines SSH target details for silent approval based on connection settings or discovery.

methods.name: probeSSH
methods.description: Performs an SSH connection attempt to verify reachability of a target host.

methods.name: updateReconcileLoop
methods.description: Manages the lifecycle of the reconcile loop based on polling necessity.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates the metrics for pending requests to reflect current queue state.

methods.name: scheduleReconcileOnce
methods.description: Schedules a one-time reconcile operation after a specified delay.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Processes remote resolution events for pairing requests and updates local state accordingly.
